findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the sealant between sinks and walls to be missing or installed in a manner that allows water to accumulate and settle into crevices. The PIC was made aware of the issue and plans to contact the construction team for repair. Ensure these seams are smooth and easily cleanable by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
